d: Native PS Vita and PSTV port of The New Tetris, with ~60 FPS solo and CPU Opponent gameplay.
ld: A native port of The New Tetris for PS Vita and PlayStation TV. All eight solo stages are optimized for approximately 60 FPS in normal gameplay. New in v1.01: all seven Single Player OPPONENT (versus CPU) cultural backdrops have been raised from approximately 30 FPS to 60 FPS, verified on real Vita TV hardware with handheld spot checks. Playfield alignment, metallic effects, line clears, pause/Progress and match results are preserved. Restored Wonders construction, WONDERS Hall and finale, original music and sound effects, saved progression and secrets remain included. PlayStation TV supports local 2-4 player games, hardware-tested with four DS3/DS4 controllers (local multiplayer is not claimed to be 60 FPS). The unofficial port involved substantial AI assistance and real hardware testing. Original game resources are generated locally from a compatible user-supplied USA 1.0 N64 ROM; no commercial ROM or extracted game media is distributed.
req: Requires a user-supplied compatible USA 1.0 The New Tetris N64 ROM in ux0:/data/TNTV/ (accepts z64, v64, n64); first launch generates assets locally. Multiplayer requires a PlayStation TV and multiple paired controllers.
